March, 2023

Author: Anjani Kumar Mishra
Bench: Anjani Kumar Mishra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 46
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 4433 of 2023
Petitioner :- Gyatri Devi And 5 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Zeeshan Mazhar Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The instant writ petition seeks quashing of the FIR dated 24.02.2023 giving rise to Case Crime No.
39 of 2023, under Sections 504, 506, 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C., Police Station-Suriyawan,
District-Bhadohi.
The contention of learned counsel for the petitioners is that it is a civil suit and also the suit for declaration regarding the plots in question have been filed and are pending consideration.
The other contention is that it a second FIR.
The first FIR having been lodged on 11.10.2021.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsel for the first informant states that the two FIRs relate to two separate incidents and occurrences and the accused persons are also different therein.

We have considered the submissions made on behalf of the learned counsel for the parties and upon a perusal of the record specially the impugned FIR, there is merit in the submission of the learned counsel for the first informant that the two FIRs pertained to two different incidents because the impugned FIR is with regard to an incident which alleges to be with regard to an incident of 03.08.2022.

Regarding such an incident, no FIR could have been lodged on 11.10.2021 and,
therefore, the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners that the impugned FIR is a second FIR cannot be accepted, being an impossibility.

Insofar as contention of learned counsel for the petitioners is that it is a civil suit and/or declaratory suit are pending, the same cannot be quashed from the allegations in the First Information Report which contains the ingredients of a cognizable offence.
For the same reason, the impugned First Information Report cannot be quashed.
The writ petition is, therefore, dismissed, without prejudice to the right of the petitioners to apply for bail/anticipatory bail.
